scripts.setup: bun install && bun run agent:sync && bun run setup:check
scripts.setup:check: node --version && bun --version && uv --version && (podman --version || docker --version) && (aws --version || echo 'AWS CLI is not installed; see AWS_SETUP.md')
scripts.check: bun run fmt:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run infra:check
scripts.dc:up: if command -v podman >/dev/null 2>&1; then podman compose -f compose.podman.yml up -d; else docker compose -f compose.yml up -d; fi
scripts.dc:down: if command -v podman >/dev/null 2>&1; then podman compose -f compose.podman.yml down; else docker compose -f compose.yml down; fi
scripts.dc:ps: if command -v podman >/dev/null 2>&1; then podman compose -f compose.podman.yml ps; else docker compose -f compose.yml ps; fi
scripts.dc:logs: if command -v podman >/dev/null 2>&1; then podman compose -f compose.podman.yml logs -f; else docker compose -f compose.yml logs -f; fi
scripts.infra:check: bun run infra:typecheck && bun run infra:test
